hook_en: Bring Him your thanks and your troubles. 🙏
reflect_en: This Sunday, God invites you to do two things: thank Him, and call on Him. Whatever trouble you carry into this week, His promise stands: I will deliver you.
q_en: What are you thanking God for, and where do you need Him to deliver you?
x_en: Call upon Me in the day of trouble; I will deliver you, and you will honor Me.
tiktok: Call on Him in the day of trouble 🙏 Psalm 50:14–15 — a Sunday of thanks and trust
yt_title: Call Upon Me in the Day of Trouble | Psalm 50:14–15 #Shorts
yt_line: Thank Him and call on Him today.
li_open: Gratitude and honest need belong in the same prayer.
li_quote: Sacrifice a thank offering to God, and fulfill your vows to the Most High. Call upon Me in the day of trouble; I will deliver you
li_body: God asks for thanksgiving and invites us to call on Him when trouble comes. Leaders who build both into their rhythm, thanking God for what He has done and praying honestly with their people about what they face, create teams and churches where no one has to carry a hard week alone.
hook_es: Tráele tu gratitud y tus angustias. 🙏
reflect_es: Este domingo, Dios te invita a dos cosas: alabarle y clamar a Él. Sea cual sea la angustia que llevas a esta semana, Su promesa sigue firme: te libraré.
q_es: ¿Por qué le das gracias a Dios hoy, y en qué necesitas que te libre?
x_es: E invócame en el día de la angustia: te libraré, y tú me honrarás.
key_en: Call upon Me in the day of trouble
key_es: invócame en el día de la angustia
